title: She Fell 33,000 Feet Without a Parachute. She Survived

scenes.text: A flight attendant fell 33,000 feet without a parachute and survived.
In 1972, her plane broke apart in mid-air over Czechoslovakia.
She was inside a section of the fuselage that fell more than six miles.
It landed in thick snow on a wooded slope, at a lucky angle.
She broke her skull, legs, ribs and pelvis. She was in a coma for ten days.
Guinness still lists it as the highest fall ever survived without a parachute.

description:
In 1972, a flight attendant survived a fall of 33,333 feet after her plane broke apart in mid-air.
She landed in deep snow on a wooded slope and made a near full recovery. Guinness World Records lists it as the highest fall survived without a parachute.
How lucky is lucky? Tell us in the comments.
first_comment: Snow and a steep forest slope saved her. What is the luckiest escape you have ever heard of?
